evidence.detail: The /decks/<int:deck_id>/ route has @auth.load_person but NO @cached() decorator; all surrounding routes (decks, metagame, cards, seasons) do use @cached()
Last comment: 'While it would be great to cache based on a key of (url, locale, is_admin_or_owner) it's non-trivial and not the most pressing perf concern right now so backlogging'
The cached() decorator uses key='view{id}{locale}' with no is_admin/is_owner dimension; extending it requires passing additional context into the cache key

triage.notes: The blocker is that the deck page shows different content to admin/owner (retire button, archetypes panel) vs public. Caching requires a two-variant key (public vs privileged), which is non-trivial to wire into the existing cache decorator.
